about: The postcommunio of the formulary “23rd Sunday after Pentecost” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: We beseech You, almighty God, let not human dangers overcome us to whom You grant joyful participation in things divine. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end. Amen.
